definition_of_100_percent: Every capability classified REQUIRED below passes every applicable RB1 scientific, numerical, architecture, hard-mass, transaction, restart, runtime and release gate on the immutable RB1 source candidate. The denominator is fixed by this file and cannot grow during F-RB01.

required_capabilities.scope: one SWAP5 kernel executing generic [t0,t1] intervals without calendar-day assumptions
explicit separation of immutable parameters, committed dynamic state, forcing, numerical configuration and results
checkpoint -> trial/retry -> commit or rollback; accepted-state authority; rejected-trial immutability; revision/lineage semantics
hard accepted-only canonical water ledger with no disable switch and no retry double booking

deterministic accepted/rejected status, retry/solver-cost diagnostics where produced by the admitted REFERENCE route, canonical mass diagnostics and process/runtime status; fallback diagnostics are not applicable because fallback is excluded

Full Richards REFERENCE route only, frozen B1.10/default-MVG hydraulic provider lineage, SWKIMPL=0, SWSOPHY=0, fixed-flux top-boundary profile and bottom mode 7 where the restricted runtime profile requires it
qualified restricted temporal acceptance machinery; explicit finite positive H_budget where that certificate is exercised; no default or application-specific H_budget claim
single logical column through the same production kernel/runtime contracts used by MultiSWAP; no separate standalone kernel
restricted serialized real-physics MultiSWAP with deterministic canonical result publication
restricted real-physics parallel V1 profile with worker-owned heavy scratch, 2 and 4 workers only, unsupported profiles fail closed
REFERENCE ET ptra to stateless restricted Macro/Feddes drought-only precomputed-QROT root uptake plus exact-runtime-forcing actual-transpiration attribution in the admitted serialized scope
root-active parallel profile: fixed-flux top boundary, bottom mode 7, SWKIMPL=0, SWSOPHY=0, finite non-negative QROT including active-zero, 2/4 workers, deterministic publication and hard mass

stateless SWINTER=0, SWREDU=0 surface-evaporation runtime materialization using qualified ET demand, committed-base ponding classification and qualified signed hydraulic capacity; accepted external solver top flux remains the sole authoritative top-water mass booking
committed-boundary external reconstruction and serialized process restart; no solver/Newton/Jacobian scratch persistence
restricted committed-boundary restart followed by 2/4-worker parallel continuation, including qualified 2-to-4 and 4-to-2 worker changes; whole-registry atomic restore before dispatch

admitted_optional.scope: restricted serialized single-level positive DIVDRA active runtime callsite with explicit hydraulic views and external scalar transfer
F-PE11/F-CI42 local surface-materialization allocation/ownership performance improvement only

explicitly_excluded: rainfall/infiltration process physics beyond externally resolved admitted top-flux forcing
surface storage/runoff physics beyond the exact already-used committed-base surface classification needed by restricted surface evaporation
SWSOPHY options outside the frozen reference profile
oxygen, salinity, frost, compensation, MICRO, Jong-van-Lier or macropore root uptake
bottom-boundary modes outside the frozen profile
worker_count other than 2 or 4 for restricted parallel execution
arbitrary composition of individually admitted optional process profiles
restart file-format or cross-version migration claims
research_only: RossFast and other alternative/reduced soil-water production solvers
universal or representative p50/p95/p99 difficult-column production-tail claims
future_release: additional parallel execution classes and worker counts
active WOFOST/crop runtime after explicit canonical admission
accepted difficult-column bounded-cost policy if independently qualified
blocked_not_required_for_rb1: representative accepted high-cost REFERENCE tail distribution
anti_scope_creep_rule: After this checkpoint, newly completed capabilities default to NEXT_RELEASE and do not change the RB1 denominator unless omission makes an already-required RB1 capability scientifically invalid.
scientific_nonclaims: RB1 is not all SWAP 4.3.1 functionality.
RB1 does not qualify all physical options.
RB1 does not establish universal MODFLOW coupling accuracy.
RB1 does not qualify RossFast for production.
RB1 is not Status A certification.
RB1 is not Status AA certification.
RB1 makes no universal performance-superiority claim.
RB1 is not validation for every application domain.
